__broaden__.αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. (αἵ μοι ἕποντο ’which followed me’) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό: fem. nom. pl. demonstrative ’they’ (ἔνθ’ αἵ γ’ ’there they’)
__broaden__.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship) · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοί περ αὐτῇ, μοι αὐτῇ ’for me myself’) · also reinforcing a 2nd-person pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σοὶ ὧδ’ αὐτῇ ’for you yourself’)
__broaden__.βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; acc. sg. · also council, assembly: ’council-meeting’ (ἐς βουλήν ’to the council’)
__broaden__.δεύεται: δεύω — wet, moisten; pres. 3 sg. mid. with retained acc. (πτερὰ δεύεται): ’wets its (own) wings’ · also pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’is drenched’ (ὄμβρῳ δεύεται ’is drenched by rain’)
__broaden__.εἶσι: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg. used with future sense: ’will come’ · also pres. 3 sg. with present force: ’goes, ranges’ (Ἄρτεμις εἶσι κατ’ οὔρεα ’Artemis ranges over the mountains’)
__broaden__.εἷσεν: ἵζω — seat, set; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’seated (her)’ · also ’settled (a people in a new land)’
__broaden__.θαλερὸν: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, swelling; adj., neut. acc. sg. (θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’) · also masc. acc. sg. (θαλερὸν γάμον ’a flourishing marriage’)
__broaden__.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’fair, fine’ (ὕδωρ καλὸν ’fair water’)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’)
__broaden__.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
__broaden__.πέντε: πέντε — five; numeral adj., indeclinable, agreeing with νέας · also agreeing with υἷες: ’five (sons)’
__broaden__.πατρὶ: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg., governed by ὁμοῖοι ’like’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person told: ’to (her) father’ (ἀγγείλειε ... πατρὶ φίλῳ ’report to her dear father’)
__broaden__.πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
__broaden__.πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’
__broaden__.τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules
__broaden__.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg.
__broaden__.φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’ · also ’carried, were carrying’ (φέρον ἐσθῆτα ’they carried the clothes’)
__broaden__.φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
__broaden__.φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg. · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (γέγηθε φρένα ’is glad in heart’)
__broaden__.ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’
__broaden__.ἤρχετο: ἄρχομαι — begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’began (to speak)’ · also + gen.: ’led off’ (ἤρχετο μολπῆς ’led off the dance’)
__broaden__.ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., + gen. ’began (the speaking)’ · also ’go first, lead the way’ (no gen.): ἦρχε δ’ Ἀθήνη ’and Athena went first, led the way’ · also + gen. of the way: ἦρχε ὁδοῖο ’led the way’ · also absolute: ’ruled, was king’
__broaden__.ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ) · also agreeing with ἔλαιον: ’liquid (oil)’
__broaden__.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’)
